verdict.rationale: Airwallex has a Bills API to create and manage vendor invoices and an accounts-payable/spend module, but the evidence describes API-level bill creation and general 'control, automate, reconcile' spend management rather than a documented UI-based bill upload feature or explicit multi-step approval workflow before payment. Missing for 10: explicit approval-workflow/approver-chain documentation, bill upload (e.g. OCR/document capture) evidence, and independent/hands-on confirmation of the end-to-end flow.
